comparison_type: Two complete VLM-proposed candidate plans under the same DD weights and execution pipeline; manually selected B for comparison, original model selected A. Different freeze moments, angles, durations and action windows, so this does not isolate any one cause.

A.visual: Stage2 orbit and Stage3 action stay recognizable in sampled frames; slight upper-edge artifact; body crop at bottom remains.

B.visual: Stage2 81-frame orbit keeps full-body person and parallax; Stage3 source action is clear but generated body/rooftop/background melt severely by around native frame12 and later.

conclusion: Original A is visibly better than B on Stage3 output despite worse source crop. Full-body visibility cannot be a hard selection gate. Need DD-aware proxy/native feedback and additional candidate-angle tests before claiming global optimality. B failure is not explained by misrun, but this comparison cannot identify whether 45-degree angle, source motion, or geometry caused it.
